 3, Rajendra Nagar, P.S- Kadam Kuan, Distt.- Patna.
 ... ... Opposite Pa  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Saket Gupta  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Anant Kumar 1  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA  ORAL ORDER 2 15-04-2024 1.

Heard learned Senior counsel for the petitioner, Mr. N.K. Agrawal and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2.

The learned Senior counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in connection with Kadam Kuan P.S. Case No. 144 of 2023 registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
It is next submitted that petitioner vehemently asserts and submits that he disputes that he was ever married to the informant.
It is also submitted that the investigation in the case is still going on.

3. The learned APP for the State submits that the offences for which the instant FIR has been instituted against the petitioner carries punishment of less than 7 years and if what has been submitted by the learned Senior counsel for the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.23936 of 2024(2)
dt.15-04-2024 petitioner is the correct fact, the said fact can be brought to the notice of the investigating authority, the said submission of the learned APP is not disputed by the learned Senior counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner.
